event.title: US Military Confirms Deployment of Space Weapons
event.canonical_title: US Military Confirms Deployment of Space Weapons
event.summary: The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, citing the need to defend against threats from Russia and China. This development has prompted warnings from both nations, with China cautioning against the militarization of outer space and Russia advocating for a weapons-free environment in orbit.

timeline.title: US Military Confirms Deployment of Space Weapons
timeline.summary: Air Force Secretary Troy Meink has confirmed that the United States possesses 'on-orbit space control weapons' designed to defend against hostile adversary actions. This marks the first official acknowledgment of the deployment of weapons in space by the US military.
key_facts: US has deployed weapons in space.
Weapons are intended to counter hostile adversary actions.
Confirmation comes from Air Force Secretary Troy Meink.
